change_summary: Added early-exit guard `if pid_m >= grid_m or pid_n >= grid_n: return` after pid-to-tile mapping to handle padding tiles when the grid is aligned to a full-wave multiple, eliminating the partial-wave tail effect; kept input_precision='tf32x3' to preserve numerical correctness (tf32 single-pass failed with max_diff ~0.19).
